sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.9

Fixes the repeated sign-in prompt some members hit when saving a card, plus checkout polish.

  • Members are no longer asked to sign in over and over. Customers whose accounts were created outside the online store (for example by winery staff) were being signed out every time they tried to save a card, check out, or join a club. They now stay signed in, can check out with a new card, and see a short "Verify your account to save cards" note with a Reset password button that fixes the account for good.
  • Checkout no longer gets stuck on an empty address step. If a previous attempt left the checkout with an address it could not show, the step now offers "Add shipping address" instead of an empty box and a confusing "Email is required" message.
  • Clearer messages at the final step. When an order needs the shopper to check their email or sign in first, that message now appears at the top of the page in plain language instead of a red error.
  • Your typed address is kept when you sign in mid-checkout. A shopper who signs in from the "this email already has an account" message keeps the delivery address they entered, rather than the order silently switching to a saved address.
  • Updating the card on a club membership now works on WordPress sites. Entering a new card under My Account → Clubs → Edit saved nothing before; it now saves and is used for the next shipment.
